name: Crypto Accelerator Analysis
description: Security assessment of hardware cryptographic accelerator engines embedded in SoCs and secure ICs. Covers AES, SHA, RSA/ECC hardware engines, DMA-based crypto interfaces, accelerator configuration and key input validation, side-channel leakage of hardware crypto cores, and assessment of countermeasure implementations (masking, shuffling, dual-rail logic) in hardware crypto blocks.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to hardware crypto accelerator analysis

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands hardware crypto accelerator architectures and common security concerns
evidence: Can explain common crypto accelerator types (AES engine, PKC coprocessor, hash unit) and their integration
Understands DMA-based crypto interfaces and key input mechanisms
Aware of hardware countermeasures against SCA (masking, shuffling, hiding) at a conceptual level

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Analyzes crypto accelerator interfaces and performs basic leakage assessment under supervision
evidence: Identifies crypto accelerator peripherals and their register interfaces in SoC documentation
Assesses key input validation and access control on crypto engine interfaces with guidance
Performs basic TVLA (Test Vector Leakage Assessment) on a crypto accelerator under supervision
Documents crypto accelerator configuration and identified interface weaknesses

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently evaluates crypto accelerator security including leakage and countermeasures
evidence: Performs TVLA or equivalent leakage assessment on crypto accelerators to identify SCA vulnerability
Assesses crypto accelerator countermeasure effectiveness through practical testing
Evaluates DMA and key handling paths for key extraction opportunities via software or firmware
Completed crypto accelerator assessments on 3+ distinct hardware targets independently

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Performs deep assessment of hardened crypto cores; combines SCA with FI; mentors team
evidence: Assesses advanced countermeasure implementations (threshold implementations, dual-rail logic)
Combines side-channel and fault injection techniques to defeat protected crypto accelerators
Evaluates the security of proprietary or undocumented crypto accelerator designs
Mentors team on crypto accelerator assessment methodology and leakage evaluation

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Recognized authority on crypto hardware security; publishes research; defines evaluation methodology
evidence: Published research on hardware crypto implementation attacks or countermeasure evaluation
Defines the lab's crypto accelerator evaluation methodology aligned with Common Criteria and EMVCo
Provides expert consultation on crypto accelerator design and countermeasure selection to IC designers
Contributes to TVLA or leakage assessment methodology development

assessment_methods.description: Assess a hardware crypto accelerator: evaluate the key handling interface, perform leakage assessment (TVLA), and assess countermeasure effectiveness
Review crypto accelerator assessment reports for leakage evaluation rigor and countermeasure analysis quality

equipment: ChipWhisperer-Pro or equivalent SCA acquisition platform
EM probe station with near-field probes for localized crypto core analysis
